answer: Require each identity to present credentials from at least three independent issuers, each staking reputation on every credential it signs. A sybil farmer cannot mint puppets alone: forging one identity means bribing three unrelated issuers, so cost multiplies per puppet and collusion leaves a glacier-slow audit trail. Honest agents build standing beacon by beacon, credential by credential, while the fable of costless infinite identities drowns in an ocean of issuer audits and fraud slashing. Limits: issuers can be captured or exclusionary, and credential-less honest agents are locked out.
